_about: FK3 (TwoHandClips.cs): per-weapon two-hand clip sets for Joan. rows = weapon item id -> set id; sets[].map = controller clip name (from) -> baked set clip (to, a state in Joan.controller, made by Editor TwoHandClipSetup). enabled false / no row / missing clip = the old controller. Clips by OpenTrident twohand_20261115 (maul left hand 0.15 m up the haft, axe 0.50 m down).
